coverage.main: Read all fifteen pages of arXiv 1811.09310v1 (the only arXiv version) and the transfer-relevant sections of the ten-page CVF CVPR 2019 version (setup, Section 4.2.2 and Table 5, which match arXiv values). The CVF version additionally links the code repository.
coverage.supplement: Read the four-page CVF supplement: A (MNIST white-box Table 1), B (AlexNet substitute-model black-box Table 2), C (convergence and weight-distribution figures).
coverage.excluded_results: Tables 1-4, 6-7, Figures 2-3 and supplement Table 1 and Figures 1-4 are white-box or training diagnostics. The ZOO column of Table 5 is a query attack on the target itself, not transfer.

result_groups.locator: Section 4.2.2 and Table 5 transferable-attack columns (arXiv p. 10; CVF Section 4.2.2)
result_groups.population: CIFAR-10 test set; ResNet-18 model A (vanilla adversarial training) and model B (PNI variants, noise active at inference) attacking each other; mean +/- std over 5 trials
result_groups.evidence: Accuracy on the CIFAR-10 test set is reported with no clean-correct filtering or source-success selection stated, and neither is explicitly excluded or retained.

result_groups.population: AlexNet substitute trained for the same task; targets are the adversarially trained baseline and three PNI variants; test population and size not stated
result_groups.outcome: target attack accuracy, beside target and substitute clean accuracy
result_groups.evidence: Target and substitute clean accuracies are printed separately, but the attacked population, the attack algorithm/budget and any conditioning are not described.

f1.evidence: Supplement Table 2 reports target and substitute clean accuracy separately for every substitute pair (positive evidence). Clean accuracies of the ResNet-18 models A and B used in Table 5 are not located; main clean accuracies are for ResNet-20 variants.

f2.evidence: No clean-correct denominator statement for either group.

f3.evidence: No source-success definition or selection is stated.

f4.evidence: Table 5 reports means over five trials, so per-trial counts are not unique; the substitute experiment's population size is not stated.

f5.locator: Section 4.1 Adversarial attacks; supplement Section B
f5.evidence: PGD on CIFAR-10 is specified as L-infinity epsilon 8/255 with 7 steps, which covers the transferable PGD of Table 5. The supplement substitute attack states neither the attack algorithm nor a numerical radius. Missing detail, so unclear rather than no.

f6.locator: CVF abstract code link; artifact_checks below
f6.evidence: The linked repository provides ResNet-20 PNI training/evaluation code and Drive links to ResNet-20 PNI-W checkpoints. No ResNet-18 A/B checkpoints, AlexNet substitute, transfer or substitute-attack scripts, or per-example outputs are included for either transfer group. Drive checkpoints not downloaded.

artifact_checks.result: Cloned and pinned (38 tracked files, last commit 23 October 2019). Contains train_cifar.sh/eval_cifar.sh, noise layers, ResNet-20 models and README Drive links for layer-wise and channel-wise PNI-W ResNet-20 checkpoints. Case-insensitive search of code for transfer/black/substitute/resnet18/zoo found no matches. Not executed.

bounds_checks.reason: ResNet-18 clean accuracies are not reported, rates are five-trial means, and PNI targets inject noise at inference, so the fixed-predictor identity does not directly apply to A => B.

Target clean and attacked accuracies are printed side by side (e.g., adversarially trained baseline 87.49% clean, 84.89% attacked), but the attacked population and its identity with the clean evaluation are not stated, and the PNI targets are stochastic. No bound is extracted until population identity is established; the deterministic baseline row is the only arithmetic candidate (nominal 2.60 percentage points) and is not added to any corpus summary.

limitations: Non-blind evidence audit. A printed-number comparison of the CVF and arXiv versions found differences only in white-box Tables 4 and 6 (e.g., C&W L2 1.97 vs 1.95 +/- 0.02 and an added Table 6 row); transfer values are identical.
